# UIOverlayComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Panel with a title that opens over the screen of a script UI; its content is built by the callback given to

`overlay`, and [`open`](#open) shows it.

## Methods

### open {#open}

::: member

Opens the panel in the middle of the screen, over the other components; the player closes it with its close button or Escape.

```js
var settings = ui.overlay("Settings", function (inner) {
    inner.label("Volume").xy(10, 10);
});

ui.button("Settings", function () {
    settings.open(0.5, 0.5);
});
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `w` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | width as a part of the screen width, 0 to 1 |
| `h` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | height as a part of the screen height, 0 to 1 |

:::
